msg: The forest color and bins had no correlation to the better gnome. I tried it. What I did notice is that one gnome was better than the other for a while before it switched up. Yellow was good at first but by the end I chose red cause it was giving me more. I started switching when the one i chose gave me a zero. do not get thrown off by the 1 or 2 mushrooms, the other side might have had zero for all we know. I got like some 250 points using this strategy through the second half. I started with clicking blue, green, brown, and yellow. Green and pink I had to switch between alot but it was worth it seeing the 45+ and 30+. the one i had the hardest time with was brown and orange. That one switched like 3 times. blue and purple i started with blue, then changed to purple and then back to blue by the end of the game. I am hoping you get the same colors to choose between as i did. If not go with like choosing bot and seeing which one seems to be giving you a bit more. Change once it shows zero mushrooms. Hope you do well!
